mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher_students r JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.student_id=r.student_id WHERE r.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND (sp.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR sp.parent_phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
AND ((#{status}='진행중' AND sp.status='ACTIVE') OR (#{status}='예정' AND sp.status='PAUSED') OR (#{status}='완료' AND sp.status='COMPLETED') OR (#{status}=sp.status))

SELECT sp.student_id AS studentId,sp.name,sp.age,sp.parent_phone AS parentPhone,sp.focus_areas AS focusAreas, sp.sessions_limit AS sessionsTotal,sp.memo,c.name AS centerName FROM student_profiles sp JOIN centers c ON c.center_id=sp.center_id LEFT JOIN teacher_students ts ON ts.student_id=sp.student_id AND ts.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND ts.status='ACTIVE' WHERE sp.center_id=#{centerId} AND sp.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ts.student_id IS NULL ORDER BY sp.name,sp.student_id

SELECT sp.student_id AS id,sp.student_id AS studentId,sp.user_id AS userId,sp.center_id AS centerId,sp.name,sp.age, sp.parent_phone AS parentPhone,sp.memo,sp.focus_areas AS focusAreas,sp.learner_type AS learnerType, c.name AS centerName, CASE sp.status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'PAUSED' THEN '예정' ELSE '완료' END AS status, sp.sessions_limit AS sessionsTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.session_id) AS sessionsScheduled, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts.status='COMPLETED' THEN ts.session_id END) AS sessionsDone, ROUND(AVG(pa.score),0) AS score,DATE_FORMAT(MAX(ts.scheduled_at),'%Y-%m-%d') AS lastSession FROM teacher_students r JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.student_id=r.student_id JOIN centers c ON c.center_id=sp.center_id LEFT JOIN therapy_sessions ts ON ts.student_id=sp.student_id LEFT JOIN practice_attempts pa ON pa.student_id=sp.student_id WHERE r.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND r.student_id=#{studentId} AND r.status='ACTIVE' GROUP BY sp.student_id,sp.sessions_limit,c.name
SELECT student_id AS studentId,center_id AS centerId,user_id AS userId,name FROM student_profiles WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_students(teacher_id,student_id,memo) VALUES(#{teacherId},#{studentId},#{memo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='ACTIVE',memo=VALUES(memo)
mapper.update: UPDATE student_profiles SET name=#{name},age=#{age},parent_phone=#{phone},memo=#{memo}, focus_areas=#{focusAreas},sessions_limit=COALESCE(#{sessionsLimit},sessions_limit),status=#{status}, learner_type=COALESCE(#{learnerType},learner_type) WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teacher_students WHERE teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND status='ACTIVE' )
UPDATE teacher_students SET status='INACTIVE' WHERE teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM therapy_sessions WHERE student_id=#{studentId}

SELECT h.homework_id AS homeworkId,h.homework_id AS id,h.student_id AS studentId,sp.name AS studentName, h.title,h.type,h.description,h.target_minutes AS targetMinutes,DATE_FORMAT(h.due_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS dueDate, h.status,(h.status='COMPLETED') AS done,h.exercise_id AS exerciseId,(SELECT ex.title FROM exercises ex WHERE ex.exercise_id=h.exercise_id) AS exerciseTitle,h.version,h.request_hash AS requestHash FROM homeworks h JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.student_id=h.student_id WHERE h.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND h.request_key=#{requestKey}

SELECT h.homework_id AS homeworkId,h.homework_id AS id,h.student_id AS studentId,sp.name AS studentName, h.title,h.type,h.description,h.target_minutes AS targetMinutes,DATE_FORMAT(h.due_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS dueDate, h.status,(h.status='COMPLETED') AS done,h.exercise_id AS exerciseId,(SELECT ex.title FROM exercises ex WHERE ex.exercise_id=h.exercise_id) AS exerciseTitle,h.version FROM homeworks h JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.student_id=h.student_id WHERE h.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND h.student_id=#{studentId} AND h.title=#{title} ORDER BY h.homework_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.attempt_id AS attemptId,pa.attempt_type AS attemptType,pa.homework_id AS homeworkId,h.title AS homeworkTitle, pa.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.title AS exerciseTitle,e.pronunciation_rule AS pronunciationRule,e.content_type AS contentType, pa.analysis_id AS analysisId,sa.status AS analysisStatus,sa.assessment_status AS assessmentStatus,sa.evaluation_mode AS evaluationMode, sa.target_text AS targetText,sa.transcript,pa.match_rate AS textMatchRate,sa.review_status AS reviewStatus, DATE_FORMAT(pa.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=pa.exercise_id LEFT JOIN homeworks h ON h.homework_id=pa.homework_id LEFT JOIN speech_analyses sa ON sa.analysis_id=pa.analysis_id WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} AND pa.attempt_type IN ('PRACTICE','SELF','LESSON','HOMEWORK') AND pa.attempt_type=#{type} ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC,pa.attempt_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_attempts WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND attempt_type IN ('PRACTICE','SELF','LESSON','HOMEWORK') AND attempt_type=#{type}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount,COALESCE(SUM(attempt_type<>'HOMEWORK'),0) AS practiceCount,COALESCE(SUM(attempt_type='HOMEWORK'),0) AS homeworkCount, COALESCE(SUM(attempt_type='SELF'),0) AS selfCount,COALESCE(SUM(attempt_type='LESSON'),0) AS lessonCount,COALESCE(SUM(attempt_type='PRACTICE'),0) AS unclassifiedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT exercise_id) AS exerciseCount,DATE_FORMAT(MAX(created_at),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastPracticedAt FROM practice_attempts WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND attempt_type IN ('PRACTICE','SELF','LESSON','HOMEWORK')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM homeworks WHERE teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND homework_id=#{homeworkId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT pa.overallScore,pa.averageMatchRate,COALESCE(pa.totalAttempts,0) AS totalAttempts, COALESCE(pa.scoredAttempts,0) AS scoredAttempts,COALESCE(pa.matchedAttempts,0) AS matchedAttempts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM speech_analyses sa WHERE sa.student_id=sp.student_id AND sa.review_status='PENDING') AS pendingReviews, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homeworks h WHERE h.student_id=sp.student_id AND h.due_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) AS homeworkTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homeworks h WHERE h.student_id=sp.student_id AND h.due_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND h.status='COMPLETED') AS homeworkCompleted, COALESCE(ts.totalSessions,0) AS totalSessions,COALESCE(ts.completedSessions,0) AS completedSessions FROM student_profiles sp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_id,ROUND(AVG(score),0) AS overallScore,ROUND(AVG(match_rate),0) AS averageMatchRate,COUNT(*) AS totalAttempts, COUNT(score) AS scoredAttempts,COUNT(match_rate) AS matchedAttempts FROM practice_attempts WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY student_id ) pa ON pa.student_id=sp.student_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_id,COUNT(*) AS totalSessions,SUM(status='COMPLETED') AS completedSessions FROM therapy_sessions WHERE scheduled_at >= #{startDate} AND scheduled_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY student_id ) ts ON ts.student_id=sp.student_id WHERE sp.student_id=#{studentId}

SELECT c.name AS label,ROUND(AVG(pa.score),0) AS score,ROUND(AVG(pa.match_rate),0) AS matchRate,COUNT(pa.attempt_id) AS attempts FROM practice_categories c LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN practice_attempts pa ON pa.exercise_id=e.exercise_id AND pa.student_id=#{studentId} AND pa.created_at >= #{startDate} AND pa.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE c.active=TRUE GROUP BY c.category_id,c.name,c.sort_order ORDER BY c.sort_order

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS date,ROUND(AVG(score),0) AS score,ROUND(AVG(match_rate),0) AS matchRate,COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM practice_attempts WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.sql: sa.analysis_id AS analysisId,sa.student_id AS studentId,sa.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.title AS exerciseTitle, sa.item_id AS itemId,sa.status,sa.evaluation_mode AS evaluationMode,sa.target_text AS targetText, sa.transcript,sa.match_rate AS matchRate,sa.comparison_json AS comparisonJson, sa.recognition_confidence AS recognitionConfidence,sa.engine_name AS engineName,sa.model_name AS modelName, sa.pronunciation_status AS pronunciationStatus,sa.pronunciation_score AS pronunciationScore, sa.speech_rate_score AS speechRateScore,sa.fluency_score AS fluencyScore,sa.overall_score AS overallScore, sa.review_status AS reviewStatus,sa.teacher_judgement AS teacherJudgement,sa.teacher_note AS teacherNote, DATE_FORMAT(sa.reviewed_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS reviewedAt,(sa.audio_path IS NOT NULL) AS hasAudio, sa.error_code AS errorCode,DATE_FORMAT(sa.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, sa.analysis_type AS analysisType,sa.assessment_status AS assessmentStatus,sa.assessment_json AS assessmentJson, sa.analysis_version AS analysisVersion,sa.teacher_confirmed_json AS teacherConfirmedJson
mapper.select: SELECT FROM speech_analyses sa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=sa.exercise_id WHERE sa.student_id=#{studentId} AND sa.status='COMPLETED' AND sa.created_at >= #{startDate} AND sa.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY sa.created_at,sa.analysis_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM speech_analyses sa WHERE sa.student_id=#{studentId} AND sa.status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') AND sa.review_status=#{reviewStatus}

SELECT ,sa.audio_path AS audioPath,sa.audio_mime AS audioMime FROM speech_analyses sa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=sa.exercise_id JOIN teacher_students r ON r.student_id=sa.student_id AND r.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND r.status='ACTIVE' WHERE sa.analysis_id=#{analysisId}
mapper.update: UPDATE speech_analyses sa JOIN teacher_students r ON r.student_id=sa.student_id AND r.teacher_id=#{teacherId} AND r.status='ACTIVE' SET sa.teacher_judgement=#{judgement},sa.teacher_note=#{note},sa.teacher_confirmed_json=#{confirmedJson},sa.review_status='REVIEWED', sa.reviewed_by=#{teacherId},sa.reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sa.analysis_id=#{analysisId} AND sa.status='COMPLETED'
